# Rules Checklist: Room Bookings

**Purpose**: Requirements quality for booking rules: completeness, ambiguity and testability of each rule
**Created**: 2026-10-18
**Feature**: [spec.md](../spec.md)

**Note**: This custom checklist is generated by the `/speckit-checklist` command based on feature context and requirements.
**Review Ownership**: This checklist is a reviewer-owned requirements-quality review artifact. Mark an item `[x]` only when the reviewer determines the requirements-quality criterion is satisfied.
**Marker Semantics**: `[x]` means the criterion has been reviewed and satisfied for requirements quality. It does not mean implementation work is complete.

## Overlap and Back-to-Back

- [ ] CHK001 Is "overlap" defined precisely enough to classify every pair of intervals (contained, partial, identical, touching)? [Clarity, Spec §FR-003]
- [ ] CHK002 Is it stated that only confirmed bookings count when checking for a clash, so a cancelled booking never blocks a slot? [Completeness, Spec §FR-003, §US4]
- [ ] CHK003 Is the overlap rule scoped to the same room, with different rooms explicitly independent? [Clarity, Spec §US1 Scenario 4]
- [ ] CHK004 Is the outcome for simultaneous requests for the same slot defined as exactly one winner, and measurable? [Measurability, Spec §FR-006, §SC-001]

## Hours, Weekdays and Boundaries

- [ ] CHK005 Is "from 08:00 to 20:00" unambiguous about whether 20:00 is a valid end and 08:00 a valid start? [Ambiguity, Spec §FR-004]
- [ ] CHK006 Is the time zone in which hours and weekdays are evaluated stated, and what happens around daylight-saving changes? [Gap, Spec §Clarifications]
- [ ] CHK007 Is the 15-minute boundary rule specific about seconds and fractions of a second? [Ambiguity, Spec §FR-004]
- [ ] CHK008 Are public holidays explicitly in or out of scope for "Monday to Friday"? [Gap, Spec §FR-004]
- [ ] CHK009 Is the no-midnight rule consistent with the 08:00-20:00 window, so it never adds a distinct case? [Consistency, Spec §FR-004]

## Duration, Past and Ordering

- [ ] CHK010 Is "at most 4 hours" explicit that exactly 4 hours is allowed? [Clarity, Spec §FR-005]
- [ ] CHK011 Is the meaning of "in the past" defined for a start exactly now and for a booking in progress? [Clarity, Spec §FR-005, §Clarifications]
- [ ] CHK012 Is a zero-length booking covered by the "end after start" rule? [Coverage, Spec §FR-005]
- [ ] CHK013 Is the order in which rules are checked specified for requests that break several at once? [Gap]

## Cancellation

- [ ] CHK014 Is the one-hour boundary inclusive or exclusive, stated identically in the user story, the requirement and the clarifications? [Consistency, Spec §FR-010, §Clarifications]
- [ ] CHK015 Is the behavior for cancelling an already cancelled booking and a booking already started or ended defined? [Coverage, Spec §US4, §Clarifications]
- [ ] CHK016 Is it stated who may cancel a booking, given there is no authentication, and that the organizer name is not a credential? [Assumption, Spec §Assumptions]
- [ ] CHK017 Is "frees the slot and keeps the history" measurable (what exactly remains visible, and to which listings)? [Measurability, Spec §FR-010]

## Rooms, Deactivation and Queries

- [ ] CHK018 Is the status for a request against a deactivated room distinct and documented, separate from invalid input? [Clarity, Spec §FR-007]
- [ ] CHK019 Does the spec say whether bookings already confirmed on a room that is later deactivated stay valid, and for how long? [Gap, Spec §FR-011, §US5]
- [ ] CHK020 Is "future bookings" defined (start after the current moment, confirmed only)? [Ambiguity, Spec §FR-011]
- [ ] CHK021 Are the organizer listing's ordering, matching and inclusion of cancelled bookings all stated? [Completeness, Spec §FR-009]
- [ ] CHK022 Are the room-day boundaries (which day a booking belongs to) defined in the office time zone? [Clarity, Spec §FR-008]

## Testability and Consistency

- [ ] CHK023 Can every rule be verified deterministically by fixing the current moment? [Measurability, Spec §FR-013, §SC-002]
- [ ] CHK024 Is the error message requirement testable ("names the rule or clash")? [Measurability, Spec §FR-012, §SC-003]
- [ ] CHK025 Are limits on title and organizer, and their trimming, consistent between the requirement and the edge cases? [Consistency, Spec §FR-015, §Edge Cases]
- [ ] CHK026 Is the one-hour cancellation rule consistent with how clients are expected to present it? [Dependency, Spec §FR-010]

## Notes

- Mark items `[x]` only after review confirms the requirement-quality criterion is satisfied
- Leave items unchecked when they still require clarification, correction, or reviewer evaluation
- `/speckit-implement` reads checklist checkbox state as a gate and must not modify markers
- `checklists/requirements.md` has a separate built-in lifecycle maintained by `/speckit-specify` and `/speckit-clarify`
- Add comments or findings inline
- Link to relevant resources or documentation
- Items are numbered sequentially for easy reference
